title: Udemy 101: Getting the Most From This Course

cues.en: Hey just a few quick tips on how to use Udemy's user interface to get the most out of this course while you're taking it.
cues.zh: 先提供幾個使用 Udemy 介面的小訣竅，幫助你在修課時充分運用這門課。

cues.en: First of all if you have any questions while you're taking this course go ahead and hit the browse Q&A button here at the bottom of any lecture.
cues.zh: 首先，修課期間有任何問題，都可以按每堂講座下方的「瀏覽問與答」。

cues.en: And that will bring up the Q&A window for this lecture and there's a good chance that whatever your question is has already been asked by somebody else and already answered so you can browse through previous
cues.zh: 這會開啟這堂講座的問與答視窗。你的問題很可能已經有人問過，也獲得了解答，因此你可以在這裡瀏覽之前的

cues.en: questions associated with this lecture here.
cues.zh: 相關講座問題。

cues.en: And if you do have a new question just hit the Ask a new question button type in a title in as much detail as you can and sundog education does have a staff of people who monitor this every day so you
cues.zh: 如果是新問題，就按「提出新問題」，輸入標題，並盡量詳細描述。Sundog Education 有工作人員每天查看這裡，因此你

cues.en: will get a response back within 24 hours.
cues.zh: 會在 24 小時內收到回覆。

cues.en: If you post a new question here also if English is not your first language or if you're in a noisy environment where it's hard to hear and keep up with what I'm saying as you're playing videos there is a speed control
cues.zh: 如果你在這裡提出新問題，就會收到回覆。另外，如果英語不是你的母語，或身處吵雜環境，播放影片時很難聽清楚並跟上我的解說，這裡有播放速度控制，

cues.en: here you can use.
cues.zh: 你可以使用。

cues.en: By default it's one XP can slow that down to point seven five or even half speed if you want to.
cues.zh: 預設是 1 倍速，你可以降到 0.75 倍，甚至半速。

cues.en: Or you can speed it up if you just want to go faster too.
cues.zh: 如果想加快進度，也可以提高速度。

cues.en: So remember that's at your disposal.
cues.zh: 記得你可以使用這項功能。

cues.en: Also you can also bring up a transcript here that actually has the actual text of what I'm saying so you can follow along there as well.
cues.zh: 你也可以在這裡開啟逐字稿，裡面有我說話的文字內容，方便你跟著閱讀。

cues.en: Or alternatively you can hit the captions button.
cues.zh: 或者，也可以按字幕按鈕。

cues.en: The CC here select your language and will actually have captions for you that actually let you follow along in text with what I'm saying as well so that can help reinforce what you're hearing too.
cues.zh: 就是這裡的 CC，選擇語言後，就會顯示字幕，讓你閱讀我說的內容，也能加強你聽到的資訊。

cues.en: Very handy tools there.
cues.zh: 這些工具都很實用。

cues.en: If you're having any trouble with the streaming of the videos click up the gear icon here and you can select different resolutions.
cues.zh: 如果影片串流播放有問題，按這裡的齒輪圖示，就能選擇不同解析度。

cues.en: Auto is usually the best choice but you can actually slow that down or make that a lower resolution if you need to and or to make sure that it streams more efficiently.
cues.zh: 通常選「自動」最好，但有需要時也可以降低解析度，確保串流播放更順暢。

cues.en: Also don't be taken aback if you see a print from you to me to rate this course very early on.
cues.zh: 另外，如果很早就看到 Udemy 提示你評價這門課，不必驚訝。

cues.en: If you're just not ready to leave orating yet there is a Ask me later button there at the bottom that you can hit and you can come back to it later on.
cues.zh: 如果你還沒準備好評分，可以按下方的「稍後再問我」，之後再回來評分。

cues.en: Please hit that button if you're not ready.
cues.zh: 還沒準備好時，請按那個按鈕。

cues.en: Don't just hit some random star rating to dismiss the window because every rating counts then it really impacts my ability to make more courses for you in a very direct manner.
cues.zh: 不要只是為了關閉視窗就隨便選個星級，因為每一筆評分都有影響，也會直接影響我能否繼續為你製作課程。

cues.en: So please an honest review when you're prompted and you're always welcome to update that review by editing it from the Course dashboard as well.
cues.zh: 因此收到提示時，請留下真實的評價。你也隨時可以從課程主控台編輯、更新評價。

cues.en: I hope those are some useful tips for you for getting the most out of this course so let's get back to the Course itself.
cues.zh: 希望這些小訣竅能幫你充分運用這門課，現在回到課程本身吧。
